next_fest_breach.name: The Next Fest Breach!
next_fest_breach.blurb: A breach has opened over the realm, and every guild is being called to hold it shut. Your heroes don't have to do anything different: every quest they finish adds Ward to the line, even while you're away.
next_fest_breach.teaserBlurb: Something is pressing on the sky above the realm. When the breach opens, every guild holds the line together: every quest your heroes finish will add Ward.
next_fest_breach.winText: The last of the Ward went up and the breach closed like an eye. Every guild that sent heroes out this week had a hand on it.
next_fest_breach.loseText: The line held, but the breach did not close. Every guild that sent heroes out kept it from opening any wider.
